title: Parse query parameters into a typed object
description: Parse a URL query string, optionally beginning with ?. Decode keys and values using URLSearchParams semantics. A key occurring once maps to a string; a repeated key maps to an array of strings in occurrence order. Preserve empty values and return an object with no prototype so a key named __proto__ is ordinary data.
signature: export function parseQuery(query: string): Record<string, string | string[]>
